name: Phone Letters Scroll
description: Phone mockup with a status bar where dated letter cards stack and fold away as you scroll inside the screen, revealing a no-more-letters empty state.
contents: Phone frame with notch and live status bar (clock, signal, wifi, battery)
Headline, stacked letter cards with date, subtitle and paragraphs
Empty state icon and message revealed at the end
behavior: Scrolling inside the phone screen scrubs a GSAP ScrollTrigger timeline per letter
Each letter compacts into a folded strip, tilts and stacks while the headline shifts up
Empty state is unmasked after the last letter
Inner scroll is capped at scrollLimit
editableByProps: Headline, empty message, and all letter dates, subtitles and paragraphs
All colors of frame, screen, cards and text
Show or hide the status bar and the phone frame

needsCodeEdit.change: Change per-letter fold tilt and offset
Change the inner scroll height for more letters

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Inner scroll container height is fixed at 4000px to give the scroll range; scrollLimit must fit within it
Phone is 375px wide (shrinks on narrow screens) and its height follows a fixed aspect ratio, so very short viewports may clip it
Loads Inter and Playfair Display through a Google Fonts import
